thread:
carmen: quick flag — seeing a wave of fncall validator failures sending traffic to the fallback_variant in eu-west-3. customers see variant token bump but console doesn't explain why.

li: can you paste a log sample? need to know if it's extra keys, missing fields, or parse errors.

carmen: log snippet: ```WARN validate: req=aa77 reason=extra_keys path=tool.response.meta route=primary -> fallback_variant```

pat: extra_keys usually means the model produced fields our adapter doesn't accept. current routing sends request to fallback and we still charge tokens to the variant. visibility is poor.

ops-bot: alert: validator-service reason=extra_keys count=58 route=fallback_variant sample=0.05

li: telemetry proposal: emit fncall_validation_total{route,reason,outcome,slice} where outcome in (accepted,soft_reject,routed,hard_reject) and reason in small enum (missing_field,extra_keys,type_mismatch,parse_error). add trace tags validation.reason and fallback_variant.

pat: +1. add exemplar label on metric so UI can link to a redacted sample: fncall_validation_total{...,exemplar="trace:abcd1234"} increases.

product: UI asks for a compact probe on the variant page: tiny sparkline "Validation routing" + top-3 reasons. clicking a reason shows redacted samples. wording should say "routed to fallback due to validation" with non-alarming language.

li: samples API suggestion: GET /api/internal/samples?reason=extra_keys&route=fallback_variant&limit=20 returns redacted json blobs. redact any key name matching /(email|phone|token|ssn|api_key)/i and truncate values > 300 chars. default sample_rate=0.05 for non-fatal reasons, 1.0 for parse_error.

pat: billing note: add event field validation_tag=routed in kafka events so billing can decide downstream. don't change charging today — tag-only.

li: alert rule draft: page if (sum(rate(fncall_validation_total{outcome="routed"}[5m])) by(route) / sum(rate(fncall_requests_total[5m])) by(route)) > 0.01 && token_rate_spike_by_route > 1.10 -> message: "validation routed >1% & token spike on {{route}} reason={{top_reason}} exemplar={{exemplar}}"

carmen: rollout plan: implement metrics+trace tags in staging -> wire sample endpoint -> enable probe in staging console -> run a 30m canary window for slice canary-3 -> if everything ok, flip for other slices.

product: tiny UX ask: when a slice toggles strict_validate on, show a banner on model page "Strict validation enabled for canary-3" with link to the probe and samples. owners shouldn't be surprised.

pat: privacy: samples API must redact tokens and any long numeric sequences that look like ids, and retention should default to 7 days.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature/validator-telemetry queued to staging by li.

carmen: thanks — pat/ li, can one of you draft the short RFC with metric names, enums, samples API spec, and the canary checklist? I'll run the validation window tomorrow 07:00 UTC.

li: will do. RFC stub: https://console.redwood.ai/rfcs/validator-routing-visibility (WIP)

pat: I'll include prom examples and the billing-tag mapping. posting when ready.

carmen: great. end thread here, followups in RFC channel. :thumbsup:
